name: e2e
description: Runs end-to-end tests for web, iOS, and Android apps where an agent follows natural-language steps, then replays verified steps without model calls. For developers and coding agents.

skills.name: Agent Steps
skills.description: Drives the app toward a natural-language goal with agent.act and checks the outcome with agent.assert inside a normal test.

skills.name: Step Caching
skills.description: Replays recorded agent actions on later runs with no model calls, and lets the agent take over again when the app changes.

skills.name: Exploratory Testing
skills.description: Explores an app from a goal without a test file, planning and performing steps, then reports the bugs it finds.

skills.name: Live App Session
skills.description: Opens a live web, iOS, or Android session for a coding agent over MCP to act on the app, check locators, run tests, and record video.

skills.name: Visual Comparison
skills.description: Compares the whole screen or one element against a stored screenshot on web, iOS, and Android in the same test.
